invariant: long-horizon autonomous-research harnessed LLM agents system
provisional_title_ko: 장기 자율연구를 위한 하네스 기반 언어모델 에이전트 시스템의 설계와 평가
provisional_title_en: Design and Evaluation of Harnessed LLM Agents for Long-Horizon Autonomous Research
focus: verified cumulative research progress under bounded total resources
primary_question: Does an explicit research-continuity harness improve the independent terminal performance of a selected research artifact over a strong iterative research agent, under the same model, tools, evidence rights, evaluation opportunities and total resource ceilings?
contribution_claim: literature-derived system design and prospective controlled evaluation; no new component novelty or efficacy is established
comparison_unit: complete research campaign within one task/source lineage

primary_endpoint.candidate: independent task-specific held-out performance of one final artifact selected before hidden scoring
prohibitions: using internal graph/schema pass as efficacy
archive per-task best as one deployable artifact
post-hoc endpoint or heldout candidate reselection

baseline.name: strong evidence-aware iterative research agent
included: same raw results and source restoration

treatment.name: research-continuity harness
registered_package_candidate: required planning use of verified results, scoped negative evidence and preservation obligations

mechanism_priorities.first_diagnostic: conditional negative-result reuse versus redundant retry and unjustified permanent suppression

first_task_search.candidate_surface: one coherent public, small-compute ML research task bundle
eligible: baseline plus multiple genuinely competing experiments
fixed metric, split, independent test and license
failure or trade-off that can inform later decisions
measurable final artifact and research report
same dataset/repository ancestry kept within one split
ineligible: task generator gold mirroring treatment graph
dataset selected using eventual treatment advantage

analysis.inference_unit: independent task/source programme; multiple research campaigns are clustered where ancestry is shared
analysis.multiple_tests: one primary package contrast; all diagnostics separate
analysis.cost: all preparation/execution/critique/evaluation/recovery and failed attempts, root plus descendants

falsifiers: equal-ceiling strong baseline matches or wins
difference explained by additional evidence or candidate opportunities
state records not consumed by decisions
negative history causes false suppression of justified changed-context hypotheses
handoff loses valid prior findings or produces worse resource-adjusted continuation
held-out performance does not improve despite visible-feedback improvement

legacy_disposition.DiscoveryWorld: optional runtime test branch deferred, not prerequisite for thesis
legacy_disposition.font_qualification: closed admitted exact host/runtime five-call compatibility only
legacy_disposition.old_literature_amendment: preserved predecessor, not constraint on new topic
